key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium dioxide–based metal-ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide process settings to target coating geometry and maximize hydrophobicity.
method: Vary detonation-spraying conditions, including nozzle passage speed and spray distance.
Characterize coating roughness, thickness, and water contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify settings for maximum hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle passage speed and roughness/thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness/contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical parameter ranges or prediction errors, so the equations require validation before transfer to other spraying setups.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
